nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Bear River Midstream, LLC's exact position in the Subterra/Belle Butte equity chain is not publicly disclosed.

Regulated-operator renaming dates and the full facility-pipeline legal inventory remain unresolved.
survivorCondition: Create exactly one manager-level Bear River platform; do not create separate PortCos for Belle Butte, Stallion, Salt Plains, their fields or operating subsidiaries.
